decision_question: Can the frozen transcript alone support a new controlled multi-target LOLA roughness panel before any additional instrument-value access?

sources_screened.title: LOLA Gridded Data Record median absolute slope products
sources_screened.publisher: NASA Goddard Planetary Geodesy Data Archive
sources_screened.possible_role: Shared roughness endpoint already used by Stage 7A
sources_screened.stage7b_disposition: NO NEW ACCESS; the transcript admission gate is evaluated first.

sources_screened.title: LROC Empirically Normalized WAC Mosaic Data Record
sources_screened.possible_role: A separately preregistered reflectance test for Reiner Gamma or Glushko/Ohm
sources_screened.stage7b_disposition: DOCUMENTATION ONLY; no raster values or tiles accessed. Reflectance cannot be mixed into the shared LOLA roughness endpoint.

sources_screened.title: Unified Geologic Map of the Moon, 1:5M, version 2
sources_screened.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey Astrogeology Science Center
sources_screened.source_class: official geologic map and GIS release
sources_screened.possible_role: Geologic-unit and relative-age control in a future cross-axis panel
sources_screened.stage7b_disposition: METADATA ONLY; no GIS package downloaded. It cannot create missing transcript comparisons.

learning_disposition: Retain only two project-local cross-axis candidates. No external source card or cross-project method change is warranted.
